versions.changelog:
- Initial release of guaikei-video-notetaker.
- Transcribes video/audio to clean, structured text using Qwen LLM, removing filler words, mistakes, and duplicates.
- Supports local files and public links from platforms like Douyin and Xiaohongshu.
- Allows customized summaries, rewrites, quote extraction, script generation, translation, and more via prompt.
- Secure processing: token-authenticated, data deleted after use, suitable for business content teams.
- Clear error handling and transparent billing by duration.
